name: synthetic-multi-value
description: SYNTHETIC chain for pdl#v5/person/enrich with a REPEATED parameter (no PDL_API_KEY held; shape from the PDL Person Enrichment reference and its multi-value example — replace via `deno task record` when a key exists): PDL widens a match when a parameter repeats, so `profile` appears twice on the query string and `name` once; the response is the same one-match envelope, still one person credit.
